title: What do you use every day?
objectives: use basic Present Simple verbs (I use, I have)

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for What do you use every day?.
Welcome to today's lesson: What do you use every day?! Today we will practice how to talk about everyday utility objects.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for What do you use every day?:
talk about everyday utility objects; use basic Present Simple verbs (I use, I have)

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: phone, computer, watch, use, have

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What object does the speaker use every day for work?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: I have a watch and a phone. I use my computer every morning.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
I have a computer and a phone. I use my computer every day for work and my watch for time.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: List three objects you use every day and explain briefly what you have.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: talk about everyday utility objects, use basic Present Simple verbs (I use, I have).
